# Brewing as both official servers report it (harness 0.34.0 brewing report: the potion registry, the items brewing
# stands take as ingredients, and every bottle (potion, splash potion and lingering potion of each potion) brewed with
# every ingredient that changes it). Java Edition 1.21.8 and 1.21.4 report the same.
# potion <registry id> <name>
# ingredient <item>
# mix <input item> <input potion> <ingredient> <output item> <output potion>
